div.div:
One full refund obligation per successful charge, including compensating duplicate/late
charges.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
payment_attempt_id: uuid [FK UQ NN]
event_id: uuid [FK NN]
reason: text [NN]
status: text [NN]
default 'requested'
amount_minor: bigint [NN]
requested_by_user_id: uuid [FK ?]
approved_by_user_id: uuid [FK ?]
succeeded_at: timestamptz [?]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (payment_attempt_id)
UQ2: (id, event_id)
CK1: reason IN
('voluntary','event_cancelled','late_payment','duplicate_charge','blocked_fulfillment')
CK2: status IN ('requested','pending','failed','succeeded')
CK3: amount_minor > 0
CK4: (status = 'succeeded') = (succeeded_at IS NOT NULL)
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(payment_attempt_id, event_id) -> payment_attempt(id, event_id) [1 parent / 0..1
children]
(requested_by_user_id) -> app_user(id) [0..1 parent / 0..* children]
(approved_by_user_id) -> app_user(id) [0..1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
Transport attempts for the same logical refund. Uncertain outcome reconciles before
resend.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
refund_id: uuid [FK NN]
attempt_number: integer [NN]
provider_refund_id: text [?]
provider_request_key: text [NN]
status: text [NN]
default 'pending'
sent_at: timestamptz [?]
resolved_at: timestamptz [?]
safe_result: jsonb [NN]
default '{}'::jsonb
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (refund_id, attempt_number)
CK1: attempt_number > 0
CK2: status IN ('pending','succeeded','failed','unknown')
CK3: jsonb_typeof(safe_result) = 'object'
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(refund_id) -> refund(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
Event-scoped payout simulation; never represents a real bank transfer.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
event_id: uuid [FK NN]
organization_id: uuid [FK NN]
payout_profile_id: uuid [FK NN]
amount_minor: bigint [NN]
currency: text [NN]
default 'KZT'
status: text [NN]
default 'pending'
request_key: text [NN]
sent_at: timestamptz [?]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (event_id, request_key)
UQ2: (id, event_id)
CK1: amount_minor > 0 AND currency = 'KZT'
CK2: status IN ('pending','eligible','sent','failed')
CK3: (status = 'sent') = (sent_at IS NOT NULL)
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(event_id, organization_id) -> event(id, organization_id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
(payout_profile_id, organization_id) -> payout_profile(id, organization_id) [1 parent /
0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
Append-only signed organizer balance effects; not a production accounting ledger.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
event_id: uuid [FK NN]
payment_attempt_id: uuid [FK ?]
refund_id: uuid [FK ?]
demo_payout_id: uuid [FK ?]
kind: text [NN]
amount_minor: bigint [NN]
currency: text [NN]
default 'KZT'
environment: text [NN]
effective_at: timestamptz [NN]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (payment_attempt_id, kind)
UQ2: (refund_id, kind)
UQ3: (demo_payout_id, kind)
CK1: currency = 'KZT' AND environment IN ('simulation','sandbox')
CK2: (kind IN ('sale','processing_fee','activation_fee') AND payment_attempt_id IS NOT
NULL AND refund_id IS NULL AND demo_payout_id IS NULL) OR (kind IN
('refund','fee_reversal','activation_refund') AND refund_id IS NOT NULL AND
payment_attempt_id IS NULL AND demo_payout_id IS NULL) OR (kind = 'payout' AND
demo_payout_id IS NOT NULL AND payment_attempt_id IS NULL AND refund_id IS NULL)
CK3: (kind IN ('sale','fee_reversal','activation_refund') AND amount_minor >= 0) OR (kind
IN ('processing_fee','activation_fee','refund','payout') AND amount_minor <= 0)
TRIGGER: reject UPDATE / DELETE (append-only).
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(payment_attempt_id, event_id) -> payment_attempt(id, event_id) [0..1 parent / 0..*
children]
(refund_id, event_id) -> refund(id, event_id) [0..1 parent / 0..* children]
(demo_payout_id, event_id) -> demo_payout(id, event_id) [0..1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.
